configuration: Standalone swiftc unoptimized production ESPNClient; isolated URLProtocol only
invariants: Eight cricket leagues produce all 72 requests with peak HTTP concurrency <= 8
Eight golf leagues with 12 tournaments each produce all 104 requests with peak HTTP concurrency <= 8
In-flight cancellation stops at the eight started requests without starting queued work
Queued cricket cancellation releases permits for subsequent work
Cricket adjacent-day duplicates have equivalent canonical event output at concurrency 1 and 8
Sports VM releases during transport I/O and cancels owned work
Source switch invalidates previous index before guide loading and replaces it with correct source
Unchanged tokens skip rebuilding and five guide requests coalesce into one publication
Visibility changes rebuild hidden fallback metadata and an empty catalog cancels pending publication
Superseded manual refresh cannot publish obsolete event content
limitations: This is a request-budget and cancellation regression gate, not a live-provider speed claim.
Capping leaf concurrency intentionally increases total burst fixture duration relative to the unbounded baseline.
Elapsed timings are single-run diagnostics; root Xcode build load may differ between before and after.
No live ESPN endpoint, user saved account, real stream or normal app UI is exercised here.
View-card cached StreamMatch arrays still need source-version invalidation outside SportsViewModel.
